cases.note: target launch carries a preferred cluster 4x2x1 (launch attribute id 11, PREFERRED_CLUSTER_DIMENSION) over the minimum cluster 2x1x1; the tracer records only the minimum, so capture and simulator treat every cluster as 2x1x1 while the hardware may form 4x2x1 clusters where resources allow. If this case's sim/ncu error deviates markedly, consider this first. Evidence: diag/pref-cluster-scan/scan.tsv (relative to CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT).
